//: What lights a fire (Prologue rule, 29.09.2026). Code: src/game/home/Fuel.js (ignitionSources, evaluateIgnition, ignite) and src/game/survival/Lighting.js (lighting a candle or a torch). Every tool listed here lights a hearth, a brazier, a candle or a torch; nothing else does. `moves` and `movesSlow` are CDDA's firestarter use-action costs (1/100 s): `moves` with tinder at hand, `movesSlow` without (a tool with no `movesSlow` lights anything as fast). `charges` is what one attempt spends (0: reusable); `chance` is the Prologue's chance that one attempt catches (CDDA has none; matches and lighters always catch). A failed attempt costs the same as a good one and the survivor tries again, up to `maxAttempts` per lighting. `needsSun` tools only work in daylight under a clear sky with nothing falling; `needsTinder` tools cannot light anything without a piece of tinder at hand and use one piece when the fire catches (CDDA REQUIRES_TINDER). `effort` names the stamina cost per minute of work in `effort`. Ignition takes no clock time: the minutes are shown and priced in breath.
source: CDDA 0.I data/json/items/tool/fire.json, misc.json, workshop.json, lighting.json, generic.json, eyewear.json, tool_armor.json (firestarter use_action moves / moves_slow / need_sunlight, charges_per_use, REQUIRES_TINDER); src/iuse_actor.cpp firestarter_actor (survival skill factor)
//skill: CDDA: the time falls by `factor` for each level of `skill`, at most `maxLevels` levels.
//sun: A lens or a scope needs the sun: one of these weather kinds (game-data/weather.json) during the day phase, and no precipitation.
//tinder: What counts as tinder at hand, in order of use (the first one found is the one spent).
//effort: Stamina spent per minute of work by kind of tool (the minutes after the skill factor).
//litLight: A candle, torch or lamp burning (a portable light with its flame lit) lights a fire in CDDA's `moves` for the lit candle; nothing is spent.
